blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: In the Global South, the lower-income countries of Africa, Asia, and Latin America where most of the world’s languages are spoken, a deployed text classifier usually runs on ordinary CPUs, serves many languages with a single model, has few labeled examples in any of them, and relies on people to catch its mistakes. Such a system is only useful if it can promise how often it will be wrong: at most a fixed fraction of the labels it assigns on its own may be incorrect, and everything else must go to a person. Split conformal prediction delivers this promise through a single confidence threshold, normally estimated on validation data pooled across languages. We ask whether the promise reaches every language, and it does not. On MasakhaNEWS (16 African languages) and AfriSenti (12 languages plus two never seen in training), a pooled threshold meets the 90% target on average but covers Somali at 77.5%, Tigrinya at 83.7%, and the two unseen languages at 77.5% and 81.2%. Estimating one threshold per language brings every language to between 89.1% and 91.0% without retraining, and it shows how unequal the cost of the promise is: keeping it means sending 43% of Somali news and over 80% of Amharic and Xitsonga tweets to a person, against under 8% of Nigerian Pidgin news. One or two hundred labels per language are enough and the models train in minutes on one CPU core, so the fix is affordable: calibrate, report, and budget human review one language at a time.
blocks.zh: 在全球南方,非洲、亚洲和拉丁美洲的低收入国家使用世界上大多数语言,部署的文本分类员通常运行在普通CPU上,以单一的模式服务许多语言,在其中任何一个语言中几乎没有标注实例,依靠人们来抓住错误。 这样的系统只有在能够保证其错误的发生频率时才有用:最多它自己分配的标签的固定部分可能不正确,其他一切必须交给一个人. 通过单一的置信阈值(通常根据各种语文的校验数据集合)进行分门别类的预测,就能实现这一承诺。 我们问,承诺是否达到每一种语言,而它没有。 在MasakhanEWS(16种非洲语言)和AfriSenti(12种加两种在培训中从未见过的语言)方面,集合阈值平均达到90%的目标,但覆盖索马里77.5%,提格里尼亚83.7%,两种看不见的语言77.5%和81.2%。 估计每种语言的门槛值为89.1%至91.0%,而不进行再培训,这表明承诺的代价是多么不平等:保持承诺意味着向一个人发送43%的索马里新闻以及超过80%的阿姆哈拉语和西松加语的推文,而尼日利亚皮奇金语新闻则不到8%。 每个语言的一两百个标签就足够了,模型在一个CPU核心上在几分钟内进行训练,因此固定是负担得起的:校准,报告,以及预算人力一次审查一种语言.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: The Global South is the usual name for the lower-income countries of Africa, Latin America, and much of Asia and Oceania. It is home to most of the world’s population and most of its roughly 7,000 languages, and almost all of those languages have little or no labeled data ( Joshi et al., 2020 ) . When a ministry, a hospital network, or a newsroom in this setting deploys a text classifier, the conditions differ from those most NLP research assumes. There is no GPU, so the model must train and run on ordinary CPUs. There is no budget for one model per language, so a single model serves all of them. Labeled data exists in the hundreds of examples rather than the hundreds of thousands, and it is produced by communities of native speakers ( Nekoto et al., 2020 ) . And because the classifier sorts things that matter, such as citizen complaints, health-hotline messages, or news that reaches an editor, a person reviews whatever the model is not sure about.
blocks.zh: 全球南方是非洲、拉丁美洲以及亚洲和大洋洲大部分低收入国家的常用名称。 它拥有世界上大部分人口和大约7000种语言, 几乎所有这些语言都几乎没有或根本没有标注数据(Joshi等人, 2020年)。 当一个部、一个医院网络或一个新闻室在此设置一个文本分类器时,条件与NLP研究的大部分假设不同。 没有GPU,所以模型必须在普通CPU上训练和运行. 每种语言没有一个模式的预算,所以一个模式为所有人服务。 标签数据存在于数百个例子中,而不是数十万,由讲土著语的社区制作(Nekoto等人,2020年)。 也因为分类者对一些重要的东西进行分类, 比如公民投诉,健康热线信息,或者给编辑带来的消息,

blocks.en: In this setting the property a deployer cares about is not average accuracy but how often the system will be wrong when it acts on its own. We call the corresponding promise a reliability contract : among all inputs, at most a fraction α \alpha receive a wrong automatic label, and the rest are handed to a person or to a larger, more expensive model. Selective prediction with a reject option is the classical way to obtain such a contract ( Chow, 1970 ; Geifman and El-Yaniv, 2017 ) , and split conformal prediction turns it into a guarantee that holds for any model, using nothing more than a held-out calibration set and a single confidence threshold ( Vovk et al., 2005 ; Angelopoulos and Bates, 2023 ) .
blocks.zh: 在这种设置中,部署人员所关心的财产不是一般的准确性,而是系统在自行行动时会有多少错误。 我们把相应的承诺称为可靠性合同:在所有投入中,最多有一小部分α-α得到错误的自动标签,其余的则交给一个人或一个更大,更昂贵的模型. 带有拒绝选项的选择性预测是获得这种合同的经典方法(Chow, 1970;Geifman和El-Yaniv, 2017),分裂的向导预测将它变成任何模型都坚守的保证,它只使用一个坚守的校准集和一个信心阈值(Vovk等人,2005;Angelopoulos和Bates, 2023)。

blocks.en: The problem this paper studies is where that threshold comes from. The obvious engineering choice is to estimate one threshold on validation data pooled across all languages. The guarantee this produces is only marginal: it holds on average over the mix of languages in the calibration data and says nothing about any single language ( Vovk, 2012 ; Romano et al., 2020 ) . Jones et al. (2021) showed that selective classification can widen gaps between groups, and languages are groups of exactly this kind. The failure is also easy to miss, because the dashboard reports the aggregate: it reads 90% coverage, and nobody checks Somali. So the question is concrete: does a single pooled threshold deliver the promised reliability to every language, and if not, what does it take, in labels and in human review, to deliver it?
blocks.zh: 本文研究的问题就是这一门槛的来源。 显而易见的工程选择是估计所有语文集合的验证数据的一个阈值。 这种生产保证只是边际的:在校准数据中,它平均持有各种语言的组合,对任何单一语言都一言不发(Vovk,2012年;Romano等人,2020年)。 Jones等人(2021年)表示,选择性分类可以扩大群体之间的差距,语言正是这类群体. 失败也容易错过,因为仪表板报告总数:它读了90%的覆盖面,没有人检查索马里人。 因此,问题是具体的:一个单一的集合阈值能否为每种语言提供所承诺的可靠性,如果不是,在标签和人文审查中,需要什么来提供呢?

blocks.en: We answer this on two benchmarks of African-language text classification built by African NLP communities ( Adelani et al., 2023 ; Muhammad et al., 2023a ) , using a single CPU core, the regime in which low-resource languages are usually the first to lose out ( Ahia et al., 2021 ; Alabi et al., 2022 ) . A pooled threshold satisfies the contract in aggregate while under-covering the lowest-resource languages by up to 12.5 points. Estimating one threshold per language, the Mondrian construction of Vovk (2012) that underlies equalized coverage ( Romano et al., 2020 ; Gibbs et al., 2023 ) , repairs this without retraining anything. It also reveals what the contract costs in each language, and it needs only 100 to 200 labeled examples per language. Code, seeds, and results accompany the submission.
blocks.zh: 我们根据非洲NLP社区制定的非洲语言文本分类的两个基准(Adelani等人,2023年;Muhammad等人,2023年a)来回答这个问题,使用一个单一的CPU核心,资源低的语言通常最先流失的制度(Ahia等人,2021年;Alabi等人,2022年)。 集合门槛值合计满足合同要求,而最低资源语言的覆盖面不足最多达12.5个百分点。 对每个语言一个阈值的估计是,蒙德里安建造Vovk(2012年)作为平等覆盖的基础(Romano等人,2020年;Gibbs等人,2023年),在没有再培训的情况下修复这一门槛。 它还揭示了每种语言的合同成本,每个语言只需要100至200个标注的例子。 守则、种子和结果随提交而来。

blocks.en: Figure 1: The deferral pipeline. One cheap model serves every language; a conformal threshold turns its probabilities into a prediction set, and only sets with exactly one label become automatic labels. The two policies differ only in where the threshold comes from.
blocks.zh: 图 1: 推迟管道。 一个便宜的模型为每种语言服务;一个符合度阈值将它的概率转换成一个预测集,只有有一个精确标签的设定成为自动标签. 这两项政策仅在门槛值的产生地有所不同。

blocks.en: 2 Reliability contracts from a single cheap model
blocks.zh: 2 单一廉价模式的可靠性合同

blocks.en: A deployment has a fixed classifier that outputs probabilities p ^ ​ ( y ∣ x ) \hat{p}(y\mid x) for inputs from L L languages, and a target error rate α \alpha for automatic decisions. For every input it must decide whether to issue the model’s label or to defer the input to a person. We want a deferral rule with four properties: in every language, at most a fraction α \alpha of inputs receive a wrong automatic label; as little traffic as possible is deferred subject to that guarantee; no retraining is needed and only a small number of labeled examples per language; and the deferral rate of each language, which is its human-review cost, is visible to the deployer. Figure 1 shows the pipeline we study.
blocks.zh: 部署有一个固定的分类器,用于输出 L L 语言输入的 p ^ (y ∣ x )\ hat{p} (y\mid x) 概率,以及自动决定的目标错误率 α\ alpha 。 对于每一项投入,它必须决定是发放模型的标签,还是将输入推迟到一个人。 我们希望有一个有四个属性的推迟规则:在每种语言中,投入的一小部分 α α α 得到一个错误的自动标签;尽可能少的流量在这种保证下被推迟;不需要再培训,每个语言只有少量的标签示例;以及每种语言的延迟率,这是其人文审查的成本,对部署者来说是可见的. 图1显示了我们研究的管道。

blocks.en: For each task we train a single multilingual model on the union of all languages’ training sets: TF-IDF weights over character n n -grams (lengths 2 to 5, within word boundaries) and word unigrams and bigrams, capped at 450k features, followed by multinomial logistic regression. The calibration layer sees nothing but the model’s probabilities, so everything that follows applies equally to a fine-tuned encoder or to a model served through an API.
blocks.zh: 在每项任务中,我们对所有语言培训组合进行单一的多语种模式培训:TF-IDF在字符n-gram(长度2至5,在字段范围内)和单词unigram和bigrams上的权重,上限为450k,然后是多名逻辑回归。 校准层只看到模型的概率,所以之后的一切同样适用于微调编码器或通过API服务的模型.

blocks.en: We use the least-ambiguous set-valued classifier of Sadinle et al. (2019) in its split conformal form. Given a calibration set { ( x i , y i ) } i = 1 n \{(x_{i},y_{i})\}_{i=1}^{n} , we compute a score s i = 1 − p ^ ​ ( y i ∣ x i ) s_{i}=1-\hat{p}(y_{i}\mid x_{i}) for each example and take the finite-sample quantile q ^ = s ( k ) , k = ⌈ ( n + 1 ) ​ ( 1 − α ) ⌉ , \hat{q}=s_{(k)},\qquad k=\lceil(n+1)(1-\alpha)\rceil, (1) that is, the k k -th smallest score. For a new input the prediction set is C ⁡ ( x ) = { y : p ^ ​ ( y ∣ x ) ≥ 1 − q ^ } C(x)=\{y:\hat{p}(y\mid x)\geq 1-\hat{q}\} , and if calibration and test inputs are exchangeable, the true label lies in this set with probability at least 1 − α 1-\alpha ( Vovk et al., 2005 ; Lei et al., 2018 ) . The deployment rule is simple: if C ⁡ ( x ) C(x) contains exactly one label, the system issues that label; otherwise the input is deferred. A wrong automatic label can only occur when a singleton set misses the true label, which is a miscoverage event, so the probability of a wrong automatic label over all traffic is at most α \alpha . This inequality is the reliability contract; we use α = 0.10 \alpha=0.10 throughout.

blocks.en: The pooled policy computes a single q ^ \hat{q} from the calibration data of all languages together. The language-conditional policy computes a separate q ^ ℓ \hat{q}_{\ell} for each language ℓ \ell from that language’s calibration data alone; this is the Mondrian construction of Vovk (2012) with language as the taxonomy, and it guarantees coverage of at least 1 − α 1-\alpha within every language. Neither policy changes the trained model (unlike learning to defer ( Madras et al., 2018 ; Mozannar and Sontag, 2020 ) ); the conditional policy additionally needs the language of each input, which a multilingual deployment already needs for routing, and a few labeled examples per language.
blocks.zh: 集合策略从所有语言的校准数据中计算出一个 q ^\ hat{q} 。 语言条件政策从语言校准数据中单独计算出每种语言的 q ^ ^ l\ q{q}_{\ell};这是以语言为分类词的蒙德里安构造Vovk (2012),它保证了每种语言中至少覆盖1− α 1- α. 两种政策都没有改变训练有素的模式(不同于学习推迟(Madras等人,2018年;Mozannar和Sontag,2020年);有条件的政策还需要每种投入的语言,多语种部署已经需要这种语言的路由,以及每个语言的几个标注实例。

blocks.en: 3 Experiments
blocks.zh: 3 个实验

blocks.en: MasakhaNEWS ( Adelani et al., 2023 ) is news topic classification with seven categories in 16 African languages; training sets range from 608 articles (Lingala) to 3,309 (English), and we use the headline plus the first 1,000 characters of the body. AfriSenti ( Muhammad et al., 2023a ; Muhammad et al., 2023b ) is three-way tweet sentiment in 12 languages with training data plus Oromo and Tigrinya, which have development and test data only and therefore act as languages the model has never seen. Conformal validity assumes that calibration and evaluation data are exchangeable, so for every language we pool the official development and test splits and, for each of 30 random seeds, divide them into a calibration half and an evaluation half; all numbers are means (and standard deviations) over these seeds. The pooled threshold uses the calibration halves of the trained languages only, and the calibration-size ablation draws n ∈ { 20 , 50 , 100 , 200 } n\in\{20,50,100,200\} examples from a language’s calibration half.
blocks.zh: 马萨卡尼瓦斯 (Adelani等人,2023年)是新闻主题分类,有16种非洲语言的7个类别;培训集从608篇文章(林加拉语)到3,309篇文章(英语),我们使用头条加上身体的前1000个字符. AfriSenti(Muhammad等人,2023a;Muhammad等人,2023b)是12种语言的三维推特情绪,培训数据加上Oromo和Tigrinya,它们只有开发和测试数据,因此是模型从未见过的语言。 形式有效性假设校准和评价数据是可交换的,因此对于我们汇集官方发展和测试的每一种语言,对于30个随机种子中的每一个,它们被分为半校准和半校准;所有数字都是这些种子的表示(和标准偏差). 集合阈值只使用训练语言的一半校准, 校准大小缩写为n {{{20、50、100、200}} n\in 20,50,100,200} 从语言校准的一半中取出例子。

blocks.en: On a single CPU core, training takes 3.4 minutes for MasakhaNEWS and 1.3 minutes for AfriSenti, and the models occupy 40 MB and 25 MB. Accuracy on the official test splits averages 87.6% on MasakhaNEWS (macro-F1 82.4, about ten points below the best fully supervised result of Adelani et al. (2023) ) and 62.9% on AfriSenti (macro-F1 57.4). The model is deliberately cheap; the point is that a correctly calibrated contract makes it safe to deploy.
blocks.zh: 在单一CPU核心上,MasakhaneWS的训练需要3.4分钟,AfriSenti的训练需要1.3分钟,模型占据了40 MB和25 MB. 官方测试的精确度平均在MasakhanEWS(宏-F1 82.4)和AfriSenti(宏-F1 57.4)的精确度分别低于Adelani等人(2023)的最佳监督结果的大约10个百分点和62.9%。 该型号是刻意廉价的;要点是正确校准的合同使得部署安全.

blocks.en: Figure 2: Coverage (top) and deferral rate (bottom) per language at a 0.90 target (dashed), mean ± \pm s.d. over 30 random splits. Trained languages are ordered by base accuracy; starred languages never appeared in training. A pooled threshold (red) over-covers well-resourced languages and under-covers hard ones (shaded region); a per-language threshold (blue) meets the target everywhere, at a very different deferral cost per language.
blocks.zh: 图2:以0.90(dashed)为目标的每种语言的覆盖率(最高)和推迟率(最低),指30个随机分裂以上的±\pm s.d. 训练语言按基础精度排序;主星语言从未出现在训练中. 集合阈值(红色)覆盖资源充足的语言和覆盖不足的硬语言(阴影地区);每个语言的阈值(蓝色)在各地都达到目标,每个语言的递延成本非常不同。

blocks.en: 3.1 A pooled threshold keeps the contract on average and breaks it per language
blocks.zh: 3.1 国家 集合门槛值平均保持合同,并按语文打破合同

blocks.en: Figure 2 (top) contains the central result. With the pooled policy, aggregate coverage is 0.902 ± 0.006 0.902\pm 0.006 on MasakhaNEWS and 0.901 ± 0.003 0.901\pm 0.003 on AfriSenti, exactly the promised 0.90, but language by language the picture reverses. On MasakhaNEWS, Somali is covered at 0.775 ± 0.019 0.775\pm 0.019 , Tigrinya at 0.837 ± 0.019 0.837\pm 0.019 , and Swahili at 0.868 ± 0.015 0.868\pm 0.015 , while Nigerian Pidgin, isiXhosa, and chiShona reach 0.964 0.964 , 0.951 0.951 , and 0.938 0.938 . On AfriSenti, seven of the twelve trained languages fall more than two points below the target, while Hausa, Igbo, and Yoruba are over-covered at 0.93 0.93 . The reason is that the pooled quantile in Equation 1 is dominated by the languages with the most calibration examples and the most confident predictions, so it is too permissive exactly where the model is least sure. Concretely, a Somali article that the pooled system labels on its own is correct 79.5 % 79.5\% of the time, not the 90 % 90\% that the aggregate figure suggests.
blocks.zh: 图2(上)载有中心结果。 根据集合政策,MasakhanEWS的总覆盖率为0.902±0.006 0.902\pm 0.06,AfriSenti为0.901±0.003/pm 0.003,与承诺的0.90相同,但从语言上看,图片反向。 在MasakhanEWS,索马里的覆盖率为0.775±0.019 0.775\pm 0.019,提格里尼亚为0.837±0.019 0.837\pm 0.019,斯瓦希里为0.868±0.015 0.868\pm 0.015,而尼日利亚的Pidgin、Iisixhosa和chishona达到0.964 0.964、0.951 0.951和0.938 0.938。 在AfriSenti上,12种训练语言中,有7种比目标低2分以上,而豪萨,伊格博,约鲁巴则以0.93 0.93的超标覆盖. 原因是方程式1中的集合方块以语言为主,其校准实例最多,预测也最有自信,因此在模型最不确定的地方过于宽松. 具体来说,索马里的一篇文章,即集合系统本身的标签是正确的79.5%的79.5\%时间,而不是总数所示的90%的90\%时间。

blocks.en: The language-conditional policy removes this disparity. Every language lands between 0.891 0.891 and 0.910 0.910 on MasakhaNEWS and between 0.900 0.900 and 0.910 0.910 on AfriSenti, aggregate coverage stays at 0.902 0.902 , and automatic Somali labels are now 94.4 % 94.4\% correct. In numbers: three MasakhaNEWS and seven AfriSenti languages sit more than two points below target under the pooled threshold and none under the conditional one, whose overall deferral rises from 6.6 % 6.6\% to 10.1 % 10.1\% on MasakhaNEWS but falls from 59.4 % 59.4\% to 58.4 % 58.4\% on AfriSenti as review effort moves to the languages that need it.
blocks.zh: 语言条件政策消除了这种差距。 每一种语言在MasakhaneWS上降落在0.891 0.891至0.910 0.910之间,在AfriSenti上降落在0.900 0.900至0.910 0.910之间,总覆盖率保持在0.902 0.902,索马里的自动标签现在为94.4% 94.4%正确。 从数量上看:在集合阈值下,3种马萨卡内语和7种非洲荷兰语比目标低2点以上,在有条件的限度下,没有一种语言。 在马萨卡内语中,总的延迟率从6.6%提高到10.1%,但在南非荷兰语中则从59.4%59.4%下降到58.4%58.4%。

blocks.en: 3.2 The price of reliability is not the same in every language
blocks.zh: 3.2 国家 在每种语言中,可靠性的价格并不相同

blocks.en: Meeting the contract in every language makes its cost explicit (Figure 2 , bottom). To label Somali news automatically at 90% reliability, the conditional policy has to defer 42.9 % 42.9\% of Somali traffic, against 9.5 % 9.5\% under the pooled threshold. Tigrinya needs 26.4 % 26.4\% , Swahili 16.5 % 16.5\% , and Amharic, Yoruba, and chiShona under 5 % 5\% . On AfriSenti the spread is wider still: 84.7 % 84.7\% of Amharic and 85.1 % 85.1\% of Xitsonga tweets are deferred, compared with 34.6 % 34.6\% of Igbo tweets. The deferral rate closely follows base accuracy (Spearman ρ = − 0.70 \rho=-0.70 on MasakhaNEWS, − 0.97 -0.97 on AfriSenti). These rates are the human-review budget a deployment has to plan for in each language; a pooled threshold hides them and spends the budget on the languages that need it least.
blocks.zh: 用每种语文履行合同都明确了费用(图2,下方)。 为了自动以90%的可靠性给索马里新闻贴上标签,有条件的政策必须推迟42.9%的索马里交通量,而集合阈值下为9.5%的9.5%。 提格里尼亚需要26.4% 26.4%,斯瓦希里16.5% 16.5%,阿姆哈拉语,约鲁巴语和奇肖纳语不足5% 5%。 在AfriSenti的推文中, 传播范围仍然更广:84.7%的Amharic和85.1%的Xitsonga推文被推迟, 推迟率紧跟基准精度(Spearman ^ = − 0.70\rho=-0.70,MasakhaneWS, − 0.97-0.97, AfriSenti)。 这些比率是人力审查预算,部署时必须用每种语言进行规划;一个集合阈值掩盖了这些比率,并将预算用于最不需要的语文。

blocks.en: With the pooled threshold, the system labels 9.3 % 9.3\% of Oromo and 16.8 % 16.8\% of Tigrinya tweets on its own, and those labels are correct only 33.8 % 33.8\% and 37.6 % 37.6\% of the time, which is chance level for three classes: a pooled threshold lets the model act confidently on a language it cannot read. A language-specific threshold estimated from a few hundred examples defers 96.8 % 96.8\% and 95.0 % 95.0\% of that traffic and restores 0.90 0.90 coverage.
blocks.zh: 加上集合阈值,系统将奥罗莫的9.3% 和提格里尼亚的16.8% 单独标注在推特上,这些标注只有33.8% 33.8 % 和37.6% 37.6 % 正确,这是三个类别的机会等级:集合阈值让模型在无法阅读的语言上自信地行动。 从几百个例子来看,一个特定语言的阈值推迟了96.8%96.8%和95.0%95.0%,恢复了0.900.90的覆盖率。

blocks.en: 3.3 How many labels does a language need, and where must they come from?
blocks.zh: 3.3 国家 一种语言需要多少标签,它们必须来自何处?

blocks.en: Per-language calibration needs labeled examples in each language, the scarcest resource in the Global South, but the requirement turns out to be modest. Averaged over languages, coverage is 0.904 0.904 with only 20 calibration examples and between 0.897 0.897 and 0.903 0.903 with 50 or more: the guarantee is unbiased even for tiny calibration sets. What shrinks with n n is the variability of the coverage any one deployment experiences: the standard deviation across seeds falls from 0.06 0.06 at n = 20 n=20 to about 0.03 0.03 at n = 100 n=100 and 0.02 0.02 at n = 200 n=200 . Smaller calibration sets also defer more ( 17.5 % 17.5\% at n = 20 n=20 against 10.9 % 10.9\% with the full half on MasakhaNEWS); in practice, 100 to 200 labels per language are enough.
blocks.zh: 每种语言的校准都需要在每种语言中标注实例,这是全球南方地区最稀缺的资源,但事实证明,这种要求并不大。 平均语言覆盖率为0.904 0.904,只有20个校准实例,在0.897 0.897和0.903 0.903之间,有50个或50个以上:即使对微小的校准套件来说,保证也是没有偏见的。 N的缩水是任何一次布置经验的覆盖率的变异性:种子间标准偏差从0.06 0.06 = 20 n = 20 到约0.03 0.03 = n = 100 n = 100 和 0.02 = 200 n = 200 = 200. 更小的校准装置也推迟了更多(在n=20n=20时为17.5%=20,而在MasakhaneWS上为10.9%=10.9);实际上,每个语言的100至200个标签就足够了。

blocks.en: The labels also have to come from the right distribution. Calibrating on the official development splits and evaluating on the official test splits leaves MasakhaNEWS unchanged but drops AfriSenti’s aggregate coverage to 0.879 0.879 , with per-language thresholds under-covering Moroccan Arabic ( 0.798 0.798 ), Algerian Arabic ( 0.848 0.848 ), and Nigerian Pidgin ( 0.848 0.848 ); random re-splits of the same data cover all three at 0.90 0.90 . Those released splits are not exchangeable, and a contract certified on a benchmark holds in deployment only if the calibration data come from the traffic the system will actually see.
blocks.zh: 标签也必须来自正确的发行. 官方开发的校准和官方测试的校准使MasakhaneWS保持不变,但AfriSenti的总覆盖率降至0.879 0.879, 单语阈值低于摩洛哥阿拉伯语(0. 798 0. 798),阿尔及利亚阿拉伯语(0. 848 0. 848),尼日利亚语Pidgin(0. 848 0. 848 ); 同一数据的随机重排覆盖所有三个,为0.90 0.90。 释放的拆分是无法交换的,只有在系统实际看到流量的校准数据时,在基准上认证的合同才能继续部署。

blocks.en: 4 Recommendations and limitations
blocks.zh: 4 建议和限制

blocks.en: Our results support four practices for anyone who deploys a multilingual classifier with a human fallback. Calibrate the deferral threshold per language, never on pooled data. Report coverage and deferral per language, because the aggregate hides the gap. Budget human review per language from the measured deferral rates, treating a high rate as a reason to collect training data rather than to lower the bar. Two limits: a fine-tuned encoder would defer less than our cheap model, though the pooled-versus-conditional gap belongs to the calibration layer, not the model; and the conditional policy relies on language identification, itself weaker for low-resource languages. One threshold does not fit all languages, and the languages it fits worst are the ones this workshop exists for.
blocks.zh: 我们的成果支持对部署多语种分类器和人类倒计时器的人采取四种做法。 校准每种语言的推迟阈值,绝不是集合数据。 报告涵盖和推迟使用每种语言,因为总数掩盖了差距。 根据衡量的递延率对每种语言进行预算人文审查,将高比率视为收集培训数据的理由,而不是降低标准。 有两个限制:一个微调编码器会比我们的廉价模型更推迟,尽管集合与条件差距属于校准层,而不是模型;有条件的政策依赖于语言识别,本身对低资源语言来说更弱. 一个阈值并不适用于所有语言,它最适合的语言就是这个讲习班所要使用的语言。
